text:
irina: noticed odd alert from audit-shipper — analytics-service started downloading customer blobs from /private-prod/kv at 03:14 UTC. this was after the nightly rbac-sync job. unsure if it's a legit change or regression.

sam: yikes. can you paste the audit entry and the rbac-sync commit that ran?

irina: log snippet: `2026-03-18T03:14:22Z audit=ALLOW principal=analytics-service action=s3:GetObject resource=s3://redwood-prod/private-prod/kv/object-42 caller=rbac-sync/commit-44a1`
commit: `git rev: 44a1f2e rbac-sync: add analytics-service -> analytics-data-reader binding (auto-sync)`

rajesh: oncall — did we change the role definition for analytics-data-reader recently? that role should be read-only scoped to /analytics/* not /private-prod/*

maria: role def last modified in infra-roles at 2026-03-17 22:01 by infra-ci. diff: `- resource: s3://redwood-prod/analytics/*
+ resource: s3://redwood-prod/{analytics,private-prod}/*` — looks like a templating bug expanded namespaces.

irina: confirmed. rbac-sync templating erroneously expanded a brace expression when env var was empty. tracer: `{{ join(',', namespaces ) }}` -> when namespaces empty produced `,private-prod`.

sam: immediate mitigation: revoke the binding and pause rbac-sync. can someone run the revoke command: `rbacctl remove-binding --principal analytics-service --role analytics-data-reader --env prod` and then `kubectl scale deploy rbac-sync --replicas=0 -n infra`

rajesh: running revoke now. output: `OK removed binding analytics-service -> analytics-data-reader (id: 7f3b)`
rajesh: paused rbac-sync job, scaled to 0.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rbac-sync deployment scaled from 2 to 0 by rajesh via kubectl (runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rbac-sync-pause).

maria: we should rotate any short-lived creds that analytics-service might have used and confirm no data exfil. oncall, can you kick off a targeted KMS decrypt audit for keys used by private-prod? query: `select * from decrypt_audit where principal='analytics-service' and time > '2026-03-17T23:00:00Z'`

oncall: started KMS audit job id=KMS-AUD-882 at 03:35 UTC. initial results: 3 decrypt calls at 03:14-03:16 by analytics-service to key=projects/redwood/keys/private-prod-key. marking ticket INS-2026-211.

irina: good catch. next steps: 1) keep rbac-sync paused, 2) ensure binding revoked, 3) rotate private-prod-key (coord with infra ops), 4) revert the templating change and add unit test for empty namespaces, 5) run a full ACL diff to detect other overstretched roles.

sam: agree. add temporary denylist rule to deny analytics-service access to s3://redwood-prod/private-prod/* until rotation completes: `policyctl deny --principal analytics-service --resource s3://redwood-prod/private-prod/*`

rajesh: deny rule applied.

maria: pushing a hotfix to infra-roles to guard templating and adding a regression test. PR: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/infra-roles/pull/918. will request security review.

irina: i'll lead the post-incident report. capture timeline, root cause (templating expansion on empty list), blast radius (buckets/objects accessed), and remediation (key rotation, denylist, unit tests, pause policy).

oncall: KMS audit job shows decrypts used only for internal metadata objects, no external egress flags. still treating as P1 until rotation done.

sam: good. once key rotated and ACLs confirmed, we can resume rbac-sync with canary mode on a subset of namespaces. add a safety check to fail if namespaces list is empty.

irina: noted. i'll update INS-2026-211 with mitigation steps and ETA for key rotation (target 04:40 UTC).

maria: ETA for hotfix deployment ~04:10 UTC. i'll coordinate and tag security on the PR. :thumbsup:

rajesh: postmortem owners: irina (sec), maria (infra), rajesh (ops). I'll keep monitoring for any other unexpected binds from the last 24h.

ops-bot: incident tracker updated INS-2026-211 status=mitigated_by_policy_pause tags=[rbac,kms,templating]

sam: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after key rotation to validate and then create a short retro to add automated ACL-diff checks to CI.

irina: thanks — closing thread for now, will add final notes to the incident doc when rotation confirmed.
